voting_record.statement: Merkley voted Nay on Senate passage of H.R. 1, the budget reconciliation bill, on July 1, 2025 (Senate roll call vote 372).

voting_record.statement: Merkley voted Nay on Senate passage of S. 5, the Laken Riley Act, on January 20, 2025 (Senate roll call vote 7).
voting_record.excerpt: On Passage of the Bill (S. 5, As Amended) … Merkley (D-OR), Nay

collection_notes: Steps 1-5 were run identically for every candidate in the US Senate, US House 1-6 and Governor races (the shared WebSearch budget ran out once mid-run and the remaining searches were completed after it reset). To keep effort equal, no T3 items are included for any candidate in these races: every item comes from the T1 voters' pamphlet, official .gov pages or official roll-call pages; promising T3 results are named in these notes for possible later, race-wide use. Campaign websites are recorded from the pamphlet but were not fetched for positions, for any candidate. oregonlive.com and apnews.com are rejected by the search proxy as allowed_domains, so step 5 used three fixed domain groups for everyone: (opb, oregoncapitalchronicle, wweek, ballotpedia), (kgw, koin, kptv, katu), (portlandmercury, vote411, pamplinmedia, portlandtribune). The Multnomah military/overseas online voters' guide was checked and contains no federal or governor statements. Pamphlet excerpts were obtained through a summarizing fetch limited to ~125-character quotes, so excerpts are short. Incumbency: pamphlet occupation 'U.S. Senator for Oregon' and merkley.senate.gov. congress.gov is robots-blocked for WebFetch, so roll calls cite senate.gov. Nominated by Democrat and Working Families per pamphlet; matches inventory.
